nom: Lancôme Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Lifting And Firming Cream - All Skin Types

segments.dry: The one reviewer who specifically recommends this for dry skin says it adds glow and helps makeup last longer.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are divided: several say it did not agree with their skin, in one case causing a reaction shortly after application, while at least one other with sensitive skin reports it didn't break her out and seemed to suit her well.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 70s and 80s, and their adult children buying for aging parents, report firmer skin with fewer wrinkles and less sagging around the jaw and jowls, with several saying friends and family can't guess their real age.

concerns.aging: The great majority of reviewers, especially those in their 60s, 70s, and 80s, report firmer skin, a visible lift particularly around the jawline, and softened fine lines and wrinkles with months to years of regular use, often saying others guess them younger than their actual age.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as moisturizing and hydrating without feeling greasy or heavy, though one long-time user says the reformulated version goes on drier than the discontinued original.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers specifically note the cream, despite containing sunscreen, doesn't irritate their skin the way other SPF products often do.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report a fading of dark spots, sun spots, and melasma with consistent use over months to a year, describing their skin as more even-toned as a result.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers specifically note the cream hasn't caused breakouts for them, including one who says she typically breaks out from moisturizers but hasn't with this one.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the cream as non-greasy and not oil-producing, with several specifically noting it doesn't leave their face looking shiny.

extraits.texte: I have been a long time customer, and I loved the "original" Renergie Lift Day Cream. Since that was discontinued, I ordered this product. It definitely is NOT the same. It goes on much dryer on my skin, and the price is much higher. Actually all of Lancome moisturizers are out of reach now for some users. I will not order again.
I can't really review this well, as I had a skin reaction shortly after applying the product. I have sensitive skin so I don't blame the product. It is hard to find a good solution for my skin.

I LOVE the spf 30 version of this product, and I'm very sad to see it has been discontinued. When it's time for a refill I'll try this spf 15 version but as a Florida girl, 30 is way better. I have seen a big improvement in melasma and sun spots while consistently using this product for about a year.

My mother has been using this face cream for over 30 years and I must say that at the age of 80 her skin is as radiant, smooth and hydrated as mine. I started about 10 years ago, and everyone is always complimenting me and not able to guess my age.I would recommend this product to everyone. It is worth every cent.
It makes my skin soft and reduces my hyperpigmentation. I have sensitive skin and it did not break me out so I am guessing it has good ingredients.
For me is the best ! I absolutely adore ! If you have dry skin or you want more glow in your face and more durability with your makeup this is the cream that you need! Believe me
I have bought this cream for a couple of years now. I use it at night, just before bed. It leaves my face soft and smooth. I have no breakouts, which I typically do with moisturizers.
